title: FAQ · bubble light grouped
description: FAQ section organized into 4 categories x 7 questions (28 slots). Each question is an H3 inside a rounded bubble that expands using native <details>. Group labels are non-heading text. First question in each group ships open.

source.adapted_from: v5 dark → light tokens. Switched to native <details> so the section works without JS.
source.decision: PM lock 2026-05-21 — FAQ pattern = bubble grouped (light)

notes: Uses native <details> — section works without JS. block.js adds slot-hiding and an `is-open` mirror class.
First item in each group ships open so the section reads correctly on first paint, including when JS is disabled.
Empty groups auto-hide — admins can ship 1 group, 2 groups, or all 4 without touching markup.
Two-column grid on desktop, single column at ≤860px.
